h1: Custom Multi Color Shirts for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Multi Color Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom multi color shirts for your team or event. Bulk pricing available at PerfectImprints.com.
introHtml: Multi color shirts let you combine several brand colors into one garment, making them ideal for team uniforms, event staff, or promotional giveaways where you want maximum visibility. Unlike single-color shirts, multi color options allow you to match your logo exactly or create a vibrant design that stands out. Choose from styles like polos, tees, or button-downs with decoration methods such as screen printing or embroidery that handle multiple colors cleanly.
heroAltText: Custom multi color shirts with colorful designs for promotional events
